dict.string: Stitchy uses audio capture only to set each app's volume. Audio is passed straight to your speakers; nothing is recorded.
Stitchy uses the camera only for Camera Mirror, while its window is open. Nothing is recorded.
Stitchy uses the microphone only while you dictate.
Stitchy turns your dictation into text, on this Mac when your language supports it.
Stitchy uses Apple Events to show artwork and controls for Music and Spotify, and to list, create and open your notes in Apple Notes.
Stitchy shows when Bluetooth devices like AirPods or keyboards connect or disconnect. It doesn't pair or control devices.
Stitchy uses your approximate location once to show local weather. You can pick a city instead.
Stitchy uses your approximate location once to show local weather. You can pick a city instead.
Stitchy shows a Focus indicator in the island when a Focus is on.
Stitchy shows today's events and reminds you before meetings. Calendar data stays on this Mac.

Stitchy watches your Downloads folder to show download progress in the island. It never moves or deletes files.
